dependency_slices.note: Complete repository fixture discovery/wrapping/run functions read; beginning of separate campaign function only.

tests.scope: Five focused tests plus one pinned-repository fixture corpus replay; no sibling campaigns or Lean compilation.

findings: PROJECTABLE denotes a data skeleton only. Every receipt retains actual_requirement_discharge gap; no new proof profile is minted from certificate tags.

State fingerprint snapshots selected graph dictionaries but omits authority_receipts. Removing that loaded map changes binding currentness while state_fingerprint stays equal. Direct state mutation control, not persisted-event bypass.

Rational characteristic-zero expressions are explicit gaps. In characteristic three 1/2 normalizes to integer two; x^3 remains a distinct polynomial from x. Parser normalization is not verified by Lean.
Unary integer constructor encoding has a 128 cost bound; it is an adapter budget, not mathematical invalidity.
Predicate projection fingerprints and retains supplied condition but does not construct its interpretation proof. Step profiles retain UNKNOWN discharge/NOT_PROJECTED justification.
Fixture corpus regression verifies deterministic source/report hashes for repository-owned fixtures; it explicitly disables binary rechecks and does not establish full campaign coverage.
Lean type names and callable Python gate references are synchronization checks, not soundness or cross-language codec proofs.
proposed_repairs: Include all authority-relevant loaded state in any fingerprint advertised as identifying current projection behavior, or distinguish structural-state and evaluated-observation fingerprints.
Preserve diagnostic-only labels, characteristic context and explicit expression gaps in consumers.
remaining: Complete separate campaign corpus runner and intake review without harvesting unconfirmed campaigns.
Further expression/budget and loaded-state mutation cases remain; semantic coverage is partial.
